description: The maximum number of customer-created aliases per CMK permitted in each AWS Region of this AWS account. Aliases that AWS creates in your account with the 'aws/' prefix do not count against this quota. An alias is a friendly name for a customer master key (CMK). Each alias is associated with one CMK, but a CMK can have multiple aliases.
